T2_privileged_frame.name: stationary_ether_hypothesis
T2_privileged_frame.statement: The ether is at rest while the earth moves through it, so the time required for light to pass from one point to another on the earth's surface depends on the direction in which it travels.

T2_privileged_frame.name: stationary_ether_hypothesis_erroneous
T2_privileged_frame.statement: The hypothesis of a stationary ether is shown to be incorrect, and the hypothesis is erroneous.

T2_privileged_frame.name: aberration_presupposes_earth_moves_through_ether
T2_privileged_frame.statement: The generally accepted explanation of the phenomenon of aberration presupposes that the earth moves through the ether, the ether remaining at rest.

T2_privileged_frame.name: fresnel_ether_at_rest_outside_media
T2_privileged_frame.statement: The ether is supposed to be at rest except in the interior of transparent media.

T2_privileged_frame.name: apparatus_motion_through_stationary_ether_alters_paths
T2_privileged_frame.statement: If the ether is at rest and the apparatus moves with the velocity of the earth in its orbit, the directions and distances traversed by the rays are altered.

T2_privileged_frame.name: stokes_ether_at_rest_at_earth_surface
T2_privileged_frame.statement: Stokes gives a theory of aberration which assumes the ether at the earth's surface to be at rest with regard to the earth's surface.

T2_privileged_frame.name: lorentz_theory_fails_if_ether_at_rest
T2_privileged_frame.statement: If the ether is at rest with regard to the earth's surface, then according to Lorentz there could not be a velocity potential, and Lorentz's own theory also fails.

T2_privileged_frame.name: velocity_relative_to_ether_determines_physical_effects
T2_privileged_frame.statement: Electric forces, molecular forces, and length are affected by motion relative to the ether.

T2_privileged_frame.name: dynamics_needs_absolute_positions
T2_privileged_frame.statement: It has not been found possible to construct a system of dynamics which has respect only to the relative positions of moving bodies.

T2_privileged_frame.name: no_disk_motion_effect_implies_stationary_ether
T2_privileged_frame.statement: Since a motion of the disks relatively to the observer and the light causes no effect, the ether is stationary, and it follows that a motion of the light and observer would produce an effect.

T2_privileged_frame.name: stationary_ether_large_square_shift
T2_privileged_frame.statement: If the ether is stationary near the earth, a single interference square of sufficient size would show a shift of more than one band width due to the rotation of the earth.

T2_privileged_frame.statement: The corresponding positions of the electrons of the two systems, established up to the first order of v/c, are true up to the second order when the moving system is contracted in comparison with the fixed system.

T2_privileged_frame.name: stellar_aberration_favours_stationary_aether
T2_privileged_frame.statement: Stellar aberration favours the theory of a stationary aether.

T2_privileged_frame.name: earth_orbital_motion_relevant
T2_privileged_frame.statement: According to the theory of a stationary aether, we have to do with the motion of the earth in its orbit and with the motion of the sun in space.
